convert_finetune_checkpoint_to_release: convert a fine-tuned PyTorch checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint by merging backbone config from the starting checkpoint
run_convert_hydra_to_release_cli: run the CLI tool to convert a fine-tune checkpoint and optional YAML config to release format
merge_backbone_config_from_starting_chec: merge the backbone and heads config from a starting checkpoint into a fine-tuned checkpoint for release
remove_finetune_config_from_checkpoint: remove the finetune_config entry from a fine-tuned checkpoint model config and save the cleaned checkpoint
convert_finetune_yaml_to_release_yaml: convert a fine-tune YAML config to a release YAML by removing finetune_config and merging backbone and heads
